iris serial killer.name: Iris (Serial Killer)
iris serial killer.first_appearance: Black Panther: The Man Without Fear Vol 1 513
iris serial killer.origin: A tenant of the building in Hell's Kitchen where Mr. Okonkwo, aka T'Challa, goes to live, welcomes him and offers to help him given that he is new to the city. ; Working as a social worker, he looked after Alec Nantakarn after his father was killed. ; Iris met Mr. Okonkwo on his way home and offered to help after hearing about an employee's accident but still got a refusal. ; Iris got advice about his attentions towards Mr. Okonkwo from Sofija who told her that he was not available, as his life was complicated. Immediately afterwards he goes to the house of Samantha, a child who received abuse and returned in the night to kill both parents. Iris was about to be captured by the Black Panther but thanks to the involvement of Gabriel Dinu and, unwittingly of Luke Cage, she managed to escape. Iris along with Gabe Dinu, met Vlad the Impaler while he was fighting with the Black Panther. She was bent on killing Vlad, but Gabe intervened by trapping her with his powers to help her father. After the Black Panther defeated Vlad, Iris attempted to escape but was stopped and stunned by Sofija, and then she was arrested for her crimes.

iris mchenry.name: Iris McHenry
iris mchenry.origin: thumb|left Iris is the daughter of Hayley and Bryce McHenry. Her father had disappeared from the family when Iris was still a baby. Iris' mother eventually passed away from her cancer, leaving Iris all on her own. She moved to New York City and became a waitress, a job she was remarkably bad at. Eventually Iris had learned that her father had passed away. One day, a Monkey had showed up at the restaurant where Iris worked. Iris saw the ghost of her dead father, and a chaotic scene ensued, which led to Iris getting fired. Not long after, her father showed up at her apartment, now explaining that was now a ghost. Iris initially refused to talk to him, but came around after Bryce came over another time to apologize. thumb|left Trying to make right by his daughter, Bryce got her a job cleaning dead bodies for Eunice Jones, a job Iris was surprisingly enthusiastic about. Iris quickly got along well with her job mentor Buddy Simpkins and had a fling with Danke, one of the assassins working for Eunice. When Eunice helped Bryce and Haruka to steal Bonsai Master's sword from the Assassins Cooperative, she called all her employees for backup, but only Iris had shown up. The four of them stood ground against an attack, which resulted in the sword being taken and Haruka being killed. After Haruka's funeral, Iris joined her father, Monkey and the rest of Eunice's assassins in stopping the Co-Ops plan to kill every human on Earth. They succeeded despite heavy losses, after which her father was fully restored back to his human form.

iris simpson.name: Iris Simpson
iris simpson.species: and Roxanne Simpson were combined in a Marvel versus DC crossover
iris simpson.origin: Iris Simpson met Blaze Allen while the two were working for the Quentin Carnival and they eventually married, but after the ceremony, the Night Spectre appeared and drained Iris of her lifeforce, because Blaze had prievously refused to give him his soul. This put Blaze into a deep depression, and he began delving more and more into magic. Blaze was helped by Merlin, who bond him with the demon Etrigan, so that Blaze could make sure that Iris' soul would rest in peace, by recovering it from the Night Spectre. After Speed Demon had chased the Spectre in his kingdom, he found Iris's soul imprisoned and freed it, but then the enemy appeared petrifying it and separating Etrigan from Allen. The two were saved by the arrive of Blaze's nephew, Wally West who was bonded by Merlin to another demon, together they defeated the Spectre and freed Iris' soul from stone, leaving it going somewhere else.

iron brain.name: Iron Brain
iron brain.origin: Not much is known about the villain known as Iron Brain. According to accounts he was a mad killer who was hung for his crimes. Under unexplained circumstances, his brain was apparently replaced with a mechanical device. He then disappeared from public view, and used his vast intelligence to construct an undersea base with advanced weapons and a biologically engineered aquatic dinosaur hybrid he called the Aquasaurus Rex. In 1949, Iron Brain developed an anti-gravity device and used it to pull the Earth into the sun. He then sent a demand to the United Nations asking them to surrender the world to him. Instead, the authorities summoned the Sub-Mariner and Namora and the pair located Iron Brain's base. Iron Brain unleashed his creation upon them and attempted to hurtle the Earth into the sun in retaliation. While Namora battle Iron Brain's creature, the Sub-Mariner punched out Iron Brain, destroying his mechanical brain. The hero then used the anti-gravity device to send the Aquasaurus Rex into space to die, and returned the Earth to it's original position. The destruction caused by the battle flooded and destroyed Iron Brain's base, washing his lifeless body away to a watery grave.
abilities: Highly intelligent and apparently knowledge in many areas of science
weapons: Iron Brain developed an anti-gravity device that was powerful enough to effect the Earth's gravitational pull and send it hurtling into the sun. He also biologically engineered a hybrid dinosaur creature he dubbed the Aquasaurus Rex.

fields.unusual_features: Entire upper skull and neck replaced by mechanical parts, apparently his brain is a machine.

iron man doppelganger.name: Iron Man (Doppelganger)
iron man doppelganger.origin: When the Magus, the dark personality of Adam Warlock, sought to conquer the universe, he first paid a visit to Anthropomorpho in the Dimension of Manifestations to create dopplegangers of Earth's every super-heroes. One such doppelgänger was based off the Avenger known as Iron Man. The duplicate attacked Stark while he was away from his fellow Avenges and bested him in battle. The doppelgänger then merged with Stark, taking control of his body. When a doppelganger of Mister Fantastic took the place of his originator, he followed through on a plan to lure many of Earth's heroes into one location, including members of the East and West Coast branches of the Avengers, the X-Men, X-Factor, Alpha Flight, the New Warriors as well as the Hulk and Daredevil together to discuss the crisis. The evil Iron Man tried to assist giving his comrade some credibility. However when both Daredevil and Wolverine outed both Mr. Fantastic and Iron Man as impostors. As a battle broke out between the heroes, the evil Reed finished activated a gamma bomb to try and destroy them all. The heroes were rescued thanks to the quick thinking of the Invisible Woman and Thor who were able to deflect the blast into space saving all their lives. The impostors of Reed and Iron Man were rescued by the Magus. Later, Sue and other heroes rescued Reed and others who were replaced by impostors. The ultimate fate of the Iron Man doppelgänger is unknown, but it presumably ceased to exist when the Magus was defeated.

iron man ii.origin: ===Early Life=== James "Rhodey" Rhodes was born and raised in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. As a child he suffered racist abuse from white children in the area of south Philadelphia, who attacked him while urging him to stay out of their park and keep to 'his own'. He would go on to be targeted by black gang members as a teen, who believed Rhodes thought he was better than as he focused on his education, rather than joining up with them. He later joined the United States Marines becoming a pilot stationed overseas. ===Meeting Tony Stark=== On a mission he was blasted out of the sky by enemy rockets, Rhodey managed to land in one piece and was attempting to get his craft airworthy when inventor Tony Stark, clad in his Iron Man Armor, happened to be passing by. Stark had just completed his original armor, had avenged his fellow prisoner Professor Yinsen, and was trying to make his way to the American defense perimeter. Attacked by enemies, Iron Man proved to Rhodey they were on the same side, and Rhodes allowed him to drain the helicopter's batteries to recharge his armor. The two then trekked through the jungle together, finally discovering a hidden enemy rocket base. Stealing an enemy helicopter, they destroyed the base, and flew to the nearest American encampment. Before leaving Siancong for the United States, Stark offered Rhodes a job as a pilot as soon as his military stint was over. Rhodey initially declined. ===Stark Industries=== After a succession of other jobs, including a mercenary stint alongside fellow former Marine Brendan Doyle, Rhodey finally accepted Stark's offer and became his personal pilot and chief aviation engineer. While working at Stark Industries, Rhodey aided Iron Man in his battles against such foes as the Roxxon Oil Company, Justin Hammer, and the Dreadnoughts. ===New Iron Man=== When devastating personal problems caused Tony Stark to abuse alcohol and become incapable of using the Iron Man armor responsibly, Rhodes put it on in order to defend Stark International from the criminal Magma. He offered to return it but Stark insisted that Rhodes take on the responsibility of being Iron Man for a while to enable Stark to enjoy himself. Reluctantly Rhodes agreed. thumb|left|Rhodey in battle, armored as Iron Man Rhodey issued notice to the Avengers that Iron Man would be on a leave of absence for the foreseeable future, unaware that several of the Avengers knew Iron Man was Tony Stark. When Cap and Wasp arrived seeking answers, Rhodey was forced to explain the real reason why Stark was no longer available. Although he was unable to help Stark from being swindled out of proprietorship of Stark International by Obadiah Stane, he did prevent Stane from taking custody of all of Stark's Iron Man armors. With Morley Erwin and his sister Clytemnestra, Rhodes embarked upon a brief career as a mercenary in order to obtain funds with which they could begin a new business venture. By the time they succeeded in raising sufficient capital, Tony Stark had recovered from his several months-long alcohol binge, and offered to join them. The four moved out to Silicon Valley, California, where they founded Circuits Maximus, a small electronics design firm. ===Secret Wars=== Stark still was not interested in resuming his Iron Man role and gave his blessing to Rhodes to continue. Rhodes was initiated into the established ranks of superhuman champions when he became one of those who participated in the first Secret Wars. Soon afterwards, he was invited to join the newly-founded West Coast Avengers by chairman Hawkeye, who believed him to be the original Iron Man. After proving his worth to the group, Rhodes revealed to them he was Iron Man's replacement. ===Side-Effects=== Soon after first donning the armor, Rhodes began to get severe headaches because the cybernetics in the helmet had never been properly re-calibrated for his brain patterns. Working in close proximity with Stark again, Rhodes began to fantasize that Stark secretly disapproved of him keeping the armor and wanted it back. This led to increasingly hostile and irrational behavior on Rhodes' part. As work therapy, Stark began to construct a new set of armor based on his original armor's design. When Rhodes finally began to endanger the lives of innocents by his behavior, Stark donned the unsophisticated new armor and managed to stop Rhodes rampage. Ashamed of his behavior, Rhodes went off to look for a cure for his headaches when adjusting the helmet to his brain patterns did not end them. thumb|right|150px|Rhodes suffering from a severe headache Stark went to the West Coast Avengers to tender Rhodes' resignation, and was invited by Hawkeye to use the laboratory facilities to create a new state-of-the-art set of armor. Rhodes returned to Circuits Maximus after the Indian mystic Shaman helped him cure his headaches, and briefly joined forces with Stark battling Obadiah Stane's latest machinations against them. fields.notes: While second armor worn by Rhodey when filling in for Iron Man was referred to as "the War Machine," Rhodey went by "Iron Man" until Tony Stark resurfaced from his apparent death. He was first referred to as War Machine in the cover of . He officially adopted the alias in-universe in . Nick Fury's intel classified Jim Rhodes as Power Level 7 while wearing the Mandroid X Armor, and Power Level 8 with the War Machine Armor.

iron monk.name: Iron Monk
iron monk.origin: The Iron Monk was an assassin working for the Hand sent to assassinate Wolverine and Pale Flower after the two interfered in the group's operations in Japan. The Iron Monk teleported into the holding cells of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police where Wolverine and Pale Flower were being held in custody. He then attacked the guards and ripped the doors off Wolverine's cell to attack him, gloating of his invulnerability and shrugging off Wolverine and Pale Flower's attacks. Yohei then appeared and gifted Wolverine with the Honor Sword of Clan Yashida, forged from meteorite iron by a demon, which he used to bypass the Monk's invulnerability and slay him.

iron moth.name: Iron Moth
iron moth.origin: Little is known about the criminal career of the Iron Moth, other than the fact that he was a super criminal who was opposed and captured by the Squadron Supreme member Tom Thumb when he was a solo adventurer before joining the team. He grew vengeful when his parents' business was taken over by Obadiah Stane and his Serpent Cartel, and used his technological innovations towards a life of crime to reclaim his financial empire. Iron Moth was only shown on a news program chronicling Tom Thumb's career. The Iron Moth was killed along with the other natives of Earth when this reality was destroyed.
powers: Iron Moth had insect-like wings that enabled him to fly. These wings and his equipment were technological in nature.

iron scorpion.name: Iron Scorpion
iron scorpion.origin: The brother of Iron Scorpion was killed by Black Widow. He planned to have revenge by lurking Widow to a trap when she was trying to find her client's son. The trap failed, as Widow discovered it before she could die in an explosion. When Widow arrived to her client's office, the Iron Scorpion confronted her and fought her, telling her the story of his brother while doing so. During the fight, the Black Widow pushed him to a truck's path, and was run over. However he survived and escaped, leaving only a puddle of blood.

iron tallon.name: Iron Tallon
iron tallon.origin: When the insane reality-warping mutant Mad Jim Jaspers took over the government of the Great Britain of Earth-238. Mad Jim Jaspers began persecuting other costumed paranormal individuals, having them hunted down and executed in order to make Britain a more safer place to live. After they became outlawed fugitives he joined the fight against the oppressive regime running Britain. The Iron Tallon was among the group that were hiding in a secret location when the Fury attacked and began slaughtering everyone there. Other people slaughtered by the Fury are, Kid Miracleman, Bash Street Bunty, the Crusader, Gaath, the Puppetman, Captain Roy Risk, the Arachnid, Android Andy, Tom Rosetta, Miracleman, Colonel Tusker and Young Miracleman. Captain UK was the only surviving hero on that day thanks to her husband, Rick, sending her away in a Ghost Box. His remains were buried in a superhero graveyard, and years later Captain Britain passed by his tombstone.
powers: Self-Propelled Fight : He also has a metal hand could generate electric shocks.

iron thor.name: Iron Thor
iron thor.origin: Iron Thor was a Thors member dispatched to Utopolis to inquire with the Squadron Sinister as to the reasoning behind their recent expansionist activities. King Hyperion asserted that their neighbors were also aggressive and that the annexations were necessary for the security of his people, to which Iron Thor remarked that they should have nothing to fear from him if that were true, before departing, stating that he would show himself around. Roughly eight hours later, King Hyperion and Warrior Woman discovered the corpse of Iron Thor and Nighthawk was tasked with autopsying the body to find the killer, then dumping the corpse in a location that would never be found, as they didn't have much time before the rest of the Thors, or possibly God Emperor Doom himself, came looking for them. Mark sought the counsel of his closest ally, Baron Sinister, to help discern who the murder might be. Sinister informed Hyperion that it was likely a traitor within his own ranks, someone wishing to personally do him harm; meanwhile, Kyle discovered Zarda was working for the Nutopians. Nighthawk used the resultant paranoia to set up Whizzer for having stole an argonite weapon and then, after Jim's death by Hyperion's atomic vision, convinced Doctor Spectrum that it was actually Warrior Woman who had killed Iron Thor, because she was working with the Nutopians, and planned to frame him for the murder. Kinji gave Kyle his Power Prism, so that he couldn't be tracked, and then fled the domain. Thereafter Zarda fulfilled her end of a previous deal with Nighthawk, to avoid being outed for betraying them to the Nutopians, by telling Hyperion it was Doctor Spectrum who had killed Iron Thor. Kyle then convinced her that she too best flee the domain. Nighthawk then utilized both the argonite and the Power Prism he'd acquired from Kinji to kill King Hyperion before being attacked by Sandman, Jacob Burnsley, and an army of Starbrands from Nutopia; however, a massive contingent of Thors intervened, taking Kyle to Doomstadt. There he stood trial for the murder of Iron Thor by means of a Power Prism he'd taken from the corpse of Doctor Spectrum during the annexation of Supremia Province, with Warrior Woman delivering the crucial testimony, that ensured he was ultimately found guilty of sowing discord within his domain, for which he was sentenced to life beyond The Shield.

iron crutch khan.name: Iron-Crutch Khan
iron crutch khan.origin: Iron-Crutch Khan was the grandmaster of a famed Kung-Fu School found in Peng Lai where students would earn the moniker of "Cobra" as a Cobra Warrior upon completing their training. The man who would become known as Fat Cobra would buy his way into the school and learn under Khan, earning the nickname Fat Cobra from Khan out of disgust for his fat appearance. Khan put Cobra through constant rigorous training and humiliation to teach him the ancient secrets of Peng Lai Kung Fu. Cobra eventually defeated the Xiang Yao serpent, but Khan still derided Cobra afterwards as a "useless fat-ass".

irving bank.name: Irving Bank
irving bank.origin: Irving was born on Long Island, New York, to Polish immigrant Meyer Banciewicz, heir to a family whose firstborn sons had been powerful mutants for generations. Meyer having been traumatized by his powers in his youth, he beat Irving in order to keep his own powers suppressed. Meyer was eventually arrested, and Irving moved to New Orleans, changed his name, and had a son of his own, David. Down on his luck, Irving took a job as an accountant for the shady nightclub owner, "Mr. D." Desperate for his son to inherit his powers and become everything Irving himself could not, Irving signed David up to be a test subject for the Adrenamix, in hopes that they could unlock his powers. They succeeded, but after another subject died, Irving asked them to release David by threatening to report them to the police. Irving continued to pressure David to make something of his new powers, and may have even been on the verge of becoming abusive himself when the mutant known as Justice intervened. He mediated a compromise between David and Irving, and a few days later mailed David his old Marvel Boy costume, in hopes that David would use his powers in the service of good.
powers: Irving could control energy to an unspecified degree, but his powers were buried within his psyche by his father's abuse and he could not currently use them.

irwin hayes.name: Irwin Hayes
irwin hayes.origin: thumb|left|100px|Irwin HayesIrwin Hayes was posted as governor of a Pacific Island following the end of World War II. The island was home of the dormant volcano Oku Sama, and became the prime choice for a new American military airbase. However, Hayes had geologist George Harris survey the land and learned that it was rich in silver deposits. Wishing to claim the silver for himself, Hayes developed the costumed identity of Doctor Weerd and developed a technological means of creating false lava flowers to give the illusion that Oku Sama was becoming active again in order to drive people away from the island until he could stake his claim. However, the activity prompted the military to send William Nasland and Fred Davis Jr. to investigate. Learning of this, Doctor Weerd ordered his men to kill them, leading to a clash with the two heroes alter egos of Captain America and Bucky. Easily defeating Weerd's men, the two heroes were forced to pull back due to the flow of lava. Returning to the village below, they consulted Hayes, unaware of his double identity, who suggested that they visit George Harris. When the two heroes went to question Harris, Weerd's men attacked again, knocking the two heroes out and kidnapping Harris. By this point, Cap decided the best way to capture their foe was to draw him out and so he informed the military that the island was ideal for a military base. In response, Weerd caused a massive lava flow that frightened the locals badly enough to make them flee their homes. Cap and Bucky climbed to the summit and battled Weerd's men, and during the fight Weerd murdered Harris. Finally catching up to Weerd, Cap easily bested him and unmasked him and learned the truth. With Hayes' plot ruined, Cap turned him over to the authorities who built their base, while the locals all returned to their homes. Hayes subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: Hayes had access to various fire arms, he also had a device that allowed him to create lava flows and earthquakes.

isaac harkov.name: Isaac Harkov
isaac harkov.origin: Isaac Harkov was a scientist who lived on Earth during the reign of the Techno-Barons. In the late twenty-second century, about 200 years after Major Vance Astro left Earth in the year 1988, Harkov made a theoretical breakthrough that would eventually make interstellar faster-than-light travel possible. Harkov's theories went unrealized during his lifetime. In the year 2525 A.D., the serfs revolted against the Techno-Barons and ended their reign. Harkov's papers and his theory were lost during the revolt. In the year 2850 A.D., Harkov's papers were uncovered in an archeological dig. The secret that had eluded mankind for centuries had at last been found, but without the means for practical application. In the year 2900 A.D., Mercurian miners discovered the mineral "Harkovite," the fuel needed to power the Harkovian hyperdrive, in quantity at Mercury's core. By the early thirty-first century, it became common for humans to speak of how "Harkovian physics" had replaced "Einsteinian physics" eight hundred years ago.

fields.notes: In , "Harkovite" and "Harkovian physics" were first mentioned in the very first Guardians of the Galaxy story, written by Arnold Drake. In , the "Harkovian hyperdrive" and "a man named Harkov" were first mentioned in this issue's story, the second in which the Guardians ever appeared, written by Steve Gerber. Details about when "a physicist known as Harkov" made his discovery and why it took so long for humans to benefit from it were revealed in the "An Outline Course in World History 1975-3015 A.D. by Steve Gerber" text page that was presented in . In that issue's story, Harkov's name was first used in an invocation when Charlie-27 exclaimed, "Holy Harkov!" Harkov was given the first name "Isaac" in the Guardians of the Galaxy profile that was presented in .

isaac ikeda.name: Isaac Ikeda
isaac ikeda.origin: The Protector showed up during a confrontation between an Asgardian Dragon and the Agents of Atlas. As the team was only trying to contain the beast in order to send it back to Muspelheim, the Protector fought it thinking that it was a threat to the people of Madripoor. He subdued and knocked the dragon unconscious with his sword and then decided to introduce himself to the Agents right before he teleported away. After their introduction to the metropolis of Pan by its creator Mike Nguyen, the Agents watched as Ikeda was thrown to the ground after he mumbled about multiple dragons invading the city. Ikeda was later shown flirting and holding hands with Raz Malhotra.

isaac sandor.name: Isaac Sandor
isaac sandor.origin: During World War II, Isaac Sandor and his colleague -- a man who eventually became known as Lord Moses -- worked on what they believed to be technology to better mankind. However they soon found out -- to their horror -- it was actually an atomic bomb. Also during this period, Sandor apparently became acquainted with the hero known as Captain America. In the Modern Age, Professor Isaac Sandor worked for Empire State University. During his tenure he succeeded in inventing the Omnivirus, a powerful virus he hoped could be utilized to cure all human illness. When the Omnivirus was targeted by Lord Moses he sent his agent Zarathustra to recover it. This led to a battle with the fledgling heroes known as Fantastic Force, who failed to recover the virus before Zarathustra could escape. Even though the viral sample was stolen Sandor was optimistic that it could be recreated. Sandor and Fantastic Force's leader Psi-Lord tried to interrogate the minions of Zarathustra and found that their minds were a blank slate, leading to the hunt for the Omnivirus to go cold. Later Sandor ran tests on Captain America, learning that at the time, the Super Soldier Serum in his system was wearing off causing a series of health problems. Later when Psi-Lord's powers were starting to manifest in the form of constructs based on other personalities (Ego-Spawn, Avatar, and Tattletale), Sandor examined the youth but found no solution to his problem. Although Sandor failed, the problem soon resolved itself. When the Fantastic Force's Devlor was gravely wounded in battle, they brought him to Isaac for treatment. Although Sandor failed to save Devlor's life, the Inhumans' unique metabolism revived him moments after his apparent death. Isaac Sandor's subsequent activities are unknown.

isabel ferguson.name: Isabel Ferguson
isabel ferguson.origin: Isabel Ferguson lived on the outskirts of Montreal with her infant daughter, Madeline. She worked from home as an independent inventor, primarily of weapons. One of her clients, Maverick, for whom she designed weapons and body armor, at a deep discount as he had once saved her father's life. It was her involvement with Maverick that lead to Ivan Pushkin ransacking her house, looking for Maverick who had been there the day before. While Isabel and Madeline hid in a saferoom, Maverick and his associate, Elena Ivanova, were captured. Isabel waited until only one security guard remained and she disabled him. Her ex-husband, Michel, arrived to take Madeline for the weekend and was furious at the danger in which Isabel had placed their daughter. Isabel agreed to cut ties with Maverick for fear of losing custody of her daughter. After two weeks of hunting down Maverick and Elena, Isabel was finally able to find Elena and free her from Pushkin's captivity. Discovering that Maverick had been brainwashed, the two tracked him down, only to discover he had thrown off the brainwashing himself. Despite her promise to Michel, Isabel continued to work with Maverick on at least two more occasions.
abilities: Gifted inventor

isabel matsueda.origin: Isabel Matsueda lived in Westview, New Jersey with her husband. While her husband was on a business trip, Wanda Maximoff arrived in Westview and transformed it into a sitcom reality. Isabel was placed under Wanda's mind control to assume the role of "Beverly". As Beverly, Isabel acted closely with "Dottie", as she helped her manage the talent show fundraiser for the town's children. Eventually, the witch Agatha Harkness released all the citizens of Westview from Wanda's spell, which led to Wanda taking down her spell over Westview and departing before law enforcement arrived.

isabel ramirez.origin: Isabel Ramirez regained her family's bible who had belonged to her great-aunt Carlotta Valdez, that contained Hawkeye's message written twenty years earlier and addressed to Firebird in the future thus returning the bible to the hands of Firebird's ancestors. In old age, Isabel gave the bible with the hidden message that she had hidden for many years to her granddaughter Chita. She later rescued a boy who was falling from a collapsed bridge, but the effort caused her to have a heart attack and die. The boy, Benito Juarez, would later become the husband of her granddaughter Chita and the grandparents of the heroine Firebird.

isabel st ives.name: Isabel St. Ives
isabel st ives.origin: During the early 20th century, the daughter of the villainous Deadly Ernest, young Isabel St. Ives, was witness to her father accidentally killing her mother, an act for which she swore vengeance on him. To gain her revenge, Isabel became Nemesis and created a sword using both science and sorcery. She first encountered the team of Canadian heroes Alpha Flight when team members Northstar and Aurora were battling her father. Using her sword, she sliced her father to pieces and, secure in the knowledge that her revenge was complete, disappeared. When her father was resurrected by the creature named Scramble and succeeded in killing most of Alpha Flight, Nemesis returned. She managed to keep Alpha Flight alive using the life force of Ernest's previous victims, and Puck used her sword to slay him once and for all. She then disappeared. A second Nemesis later appeared as the leader of the second Gamma Flight.
weaknesses: If she is separated from her sword, her body begins to degenerate.

isabelle donovan.name: Isabelle Donovan
isabelle donovan.origin: Isabelle was an orphaned child who lived with her foster family. One night, while drawing in her room, she witnessed a murder committed by Elektra commissioned by Wilson Fisk (the Kingpin), through the window of her home. To prevent the girl from being killed, Elektra asked Emma Frost for help in making Isabelle forget about the murder, but when they got to her, she had already told her parents and they had already warned the police, resulting in a squad of corrupt cops being on their way to kill the girl, per Kingpin's orders. The two women, with the help of Spider-Man, managed to get the girl to safety, but Emma had to send her to England with a new identity, for her own safety. Later, unbeknownst to Emma, Isabelle was trained in martial arts by Elektra herself, trying to make amends for causing her suffer such a traumatic event. Years after this life-changing event, Wilson Fisk, now the Mayor of New York, seeking to get revenge on Emma for thwarting his move against the X-Men operations as part of his crackdown on vigilantes, had it was revealed that Emma had been the last one to see Isabelle before her disappearance. To clear up her name, Emma flew to England, reencountering Isabelle all grown up, and asked her to accompany her to New York, where she revealed the truth to the Daily Bugle reporter Ben Urich, successfully getting the truth out there and putting Fisk in a bad light. With Isabelle's return to the UK being somewhat complicated after having attacked police and Union Jack, Emma advised her to see the world instead, assuring her that she'd be welcome in any Hellfire Club mansion.

isaiah ross.name: Isaiah Ross
isaiah ross.origin: Isaiah Ross was Black Widow's counselor, who found her contracts as part of her atonement for her past. Black Widow was Isaiah's only client, and he felt indebted to her, staying by her side to offer her a person she could trust. At one point in his life, Isaiah and his sister Carrie were involved with the mob, but he got both of them out of it. Isaiah would also take care of Natasha's cat Liho whenever she was out of the country. Ross was kidnapped by Rashid on behalf of the organization Chaos, but he was eventually rescued by Natasha. When Chaos exposed Black Widow on the media, Ross arranged to meet her in her apartment. As he was trying to feed Liho, Rashid approached him from behind and shot him. Isaiah survived the attack and was hospitalized. Now that she was compromised, Isaiah let Natasha stay in his brother's house upstate, hoping she would use the opportunity to lay low for a while. Soon after Black Widow faced Chaos and killed their leader, she decided to retire, and bid farewell to Isaiah, wishing him well for his future.

ishiti.species: Demon Goddess, snake goddess, snake demoness
ishiti.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Ishiti was a daughter of Set, and his snake-goddess and snake-demoness. She begat the Man Serpents, the Snake-People, and (possibly only metaphorically) all of the serpents. ===Hyborian Age=== Ishiti was prayed to by Eshe Lon, a wizard she considered a faithful servant. When Eshe's daughter, Pelija, was captured and condemned to the pyre for the murder of her lover Ranj (whom Eshe had killed to keep Pelija by his side), Eshe Lon prayed to Ishiti, who was unable to save her as she was instants from her death. Ishiti produced an asp who bit Eshe, then stopped time for all but the serpents and those who had serpent venom in their veins. Ishiti also gave him a dose of antidote. On the site of the execution, Eshe was unable to save his daughter, but encountered Conan who had himself been bit by a pit viper instant before. Conan helped Eshe in exchange for the antidote to the venom, but Eshe used the only dose on himself while his hand in Ranj's death was revealed by Pelija. Feeling betrayed by Eshe Lon, who acted for his own selfish needs only, Ishiti appeared, raptured Eshe, cured Conan of the venom killing him, and disappeared. back to her hidden depths with Eshe.
powers: Ishiti could stop time for all creatures and inanimate objects, save for her children the serpents and any creature who had serpent venom running in its vein.

isparana.name: Isparana
isparana.origin: ===Origins and Early Years=== During the Hyborian Age, Isparana was a thief from Squatter's Alley, in Zamboula. It was also hypothesized (though it was stated in a defamatory rant) that she had been a prostitute on Zamboula's streets as well. She possibly had Stygian origins (see notes). ===Free Companions=== She became one of Conan's . When they reached Bisara after escaping the Kothians, Ispara congratulated with Conan and approved his leadership. After they docked in the Islands of Pearl and met Acheron, she was instantly charmed by his persona. As Conan and the Free Companions set up camp on Dagoth Hill, Acheron and Isparana continued to grow closer, and one night they consummated their love. However, that same night, Acheron was awakened from his sleep and drawn into the catacombs, where he found the empty armor of the Devourer. Isparana awakened and followed Acheron, while Conan heard their voices and investigated. Conan threatened Acheron to keep away from the armor, which caused Isparana to draw her sword to defend him. As Conan and Isparana struggled, Acheron fell the rest of the way under the sway of the call of the Devourer, and he donned the helmet. After putting on the entire suit of armor, Acheron was transformed both physically and mentally back into the Devourer. When Conan escaped from the catacombs and confronted the Devourer, Isparana joined him, but their swords were no match for the Devourer. However, as Conan struggled vainly in hand-to-hand combat with the giant Devourer, smoke began to billow forth from the Devourer as it was consumed from within. The face of Acheron appeared once again within the helmet of the Devourer, and he told Isparana that his love for her kept his human aspect alive, and that he had managed to destroy the Devourer. The effort cost him, however, as his human body crumbled to dust, and the armor collapsed empty to the ground. When they set up camp in an oasis not far from Shadizar, Conan let her sleep in his tent because of her nightmares, but she couldn't stop the assassins of the Night Cult from kidnapping the Cimmerian and bringing him back to Shadizar. When Conan returned to the mercenary camp and his captainship was replaced by Milo, she didn't help the Cimmerian, afraid to endanger the child she bearing. She then decided to stay with the Free Companions and met Conan again in the Turanian steppes. She briefly stayed with the Cimmerian at the Kozak camp, but overnight she sneaked away unnoticed.

ister.name: Ister
ister.origin: thumb|left|275px|With his Ister's Sister (Earth-616)|sister, witnessing the Black Death ===Early Years=== Ister was a Proto-Mutant, the offshoot of humanity in which the X-Gene first evolved. 600 years ago, the proto-mutants living in Crimea, including Ister, were massacred by superstitious baseline humans, due to their resistance to the black plague that was occurring, and their bodies dumped into a mass grave. His own sister was killed for her blood to be drunk, thought to be a cure for the disease. left|thumb|Intercepted by Psylocke ===Modern Days=== In modern times, the grave (in Kuryk, Kazakhstan) was rediscovered by the mad scientist, Dr. David Michael Gray, created clones from the 600 year old dead Proto-Mutants. Ister was one of the many Proto-Mutants cloned by Gray, and due to the memory-storing DNA the Proto-Mutants seem to all share, the clone of Ister retained all of his memories. Gray sent the giant-sized Ister on a rampage through Canada, but he was telepathically calmed by the X-Men's Psylocke and reverted to his normal size. Ister was taken into the X-Men's custody, and told them his story with Illyana Rasputin acting as translator. Unfortunately for Ister, Gray deemed that he had divulged too much information, and shut off his brain remotely, killing him. His memories were stored inside Psylocke, and through her, he was able to see and grieve his dead sister who was found in Gray's lab, automatically killed when Gray committed suicide. Both bodies were later ceremonially burned.

isuus.origin: ===Origin=== Issus (or Isuus, see notes) was one of the Elder Gods of Earth, and the sister of Father Set. Her fate during the degeneration of the Elder Gods into demons and their slaughter by the Demogorge remains unknown. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age , the goddess Issus was worshiped by Nitocris, queen of Stygia. Issus' name was invoked by Stornella in the spell to resurrect Ctesphon and have her mind hurled into the Outer Darkness while Stornella's mind would inhabit Ctesphon's body.

it artificial lifeform.name: It (Artificial Lifeform)
it artificial lifeform.origin: left|150px|thumb Heinrich Munch, a brilliant scientist in Europe, received a telegram informing him that he had lost a prestigious scientific award to a life-long rival. Infuriated, the scientist vowed revenge and set upon using his intellect to building a creation that would destroy his old foe. He spent months building a giant monster made of plastic, but continued to fail to bring it to life. After several unsuccessful attempts, Munch decided to abandon his project and dumped the giant body into his moat of quicksand outside of his castle. Unknown to the scientist, however, an unknown chemical present in the quicksand itself was the missing element needed to bring his creation to life. The monster pulled itself out of the muck and smashed through the castle door in search of its master. it the silent one.species: Emerged from ooze when Namor disposed of radioactive waste in the Cavern of Darkness under the sea.
it the silent one.origin: It, the Silent One, was roused from its centuries-long slumber when Namor the Sub-Mariner discovered a barrel containing radioactive waste had fallen from a passing submarine. Wanting to get rid of it so it would not harm his fellow Atlanteans, he traveled to the Cavern of Darkness and threw the barrel into the bottomless ooze below. The barrel exploded and the resulting radiation awoke It. Its origin has been lost in the dim, forgotten past, and at one time it perhaps possessed a name. Attacking a human outpost and sinking it, It discovered and attacked a group of Atlanteans, attracting Namor's attention. Confronting It, Namor battleed It before the pair are fired upon by a submarine. It, buried under a pile of rubble and seeking revenge, removed the mound of rock above him and vowed to kill Namor. However, Namor again won the rematch and handed It over to the humans for safe keeping.

itaru ozu.name: Itaru Ozu
itaru ozu.origin: Itaru Ozu ran for the position of the Prime Minister of Japan against Ken Takahara, whom he was leading by ten points when Ken was assassinated during a campaign rally. Ozu assumed that with his major opponent gone, the race would be his, only to have Ozu's former campaign manager Shinji Yokohama to run in his place, which greatly irritated Ozu. Over the course of the campaign Shinji closed the gap between them, and on the election night Ozu watched the final results from a private party thrown by his major donor, the Bonsai Master. The estate was attacked by Hit-Monkey who killed the guards and the Bonsai Master before coming face to face with Ozu. Panicking, Ozu swore that he did not order the hit on Takahara, as he had the least to gain from it, exposing Shinji Yokohama as the one true culprit, who had also just announced to have won the race.

itzhak berditchev.name: Itzhak Berditchev
itzhak berditchev.origin: As a child, Berditchev was saved from a Nazi by Captain America during World War II. He became an admirer of the hero and claimed to dedicate his life to following his example and swore to never be a victim again. He entered the business of weapons manufacturing and became known as a reclusive man. He married Heidi Ehman, with her eventually gave birth to quintuplets in Switzerland. He used his own children as a security force for his state, claiming that they would become the "super soldiers of of tomorrow". Paranoid with the possibility of World War III, Berditchev stole a stock pile of plutonium from his native country and planned to create a nuclear bomb to hold the world hostage. This plan was stopped by the Avengers after they were warned by the businessman's wife. After his defeat, Berditchev had a mental breakdown, starting to speak like a child claiming for his mother. As he was being imprisoned, the Avengers learned that Mrs. Ehman was expected to make a full recovery and would eventually return to her children.

family: Heidi Ehman (wife) Joey (son) 4 other unnamed sons

itzpapalotl.name: Itzpapalotl
itzpapalotl.origin: ===Origin and early years=== In Aztec legend, Itzpapalotl was one of the Tzitzimime, demons from the stars, who stood for purification or rejuvenation through the sacrifice of that which is precious. A legend stated that other Gods imprisoned her in a tomb in the Aztec city of Tenochtitlan (located in modern days under the The Zócalo in Mexico City), and was held prisoner using the Jade Mask. ===Modern days=== In modern days, an earthquake caused by Diablo (in his quest of the Masks of Death) to unearth the tomb opened it, dislodged the jade mask and awoke Itzpapalotl, and she returned to the surface for the time of purification, demanding blood sacrifice. Spider-Man, helped by Parker Industries Mexico archaeologist Veronica Diaz, was able to bind Itzpapalotl back. As Parker promised to go back underground to preserve the site, Diablo replaced the Jade Mask with a replica alchemically treated to keep Itzpapalotl inert.

ivan frankenstein.name: Ivan (Frankenstein)
ivan frankenstein.origin: Having gotten much better over the next century, Ivan came under the alliance of Dr. Walston Kraft, who wished to clone an army of Frankenstein's Monsters (Frankenclones) and promised Ivan Frankenstein's Monster's body for himself. Ivan located the Monster at Victoria Frankenstein's castle and convinced him to join Kraft who, Ivan claimed, could give him a "real body." Ivan returned to Victoria's castle and imprisoned her in its dungeon to prevent her from interfering with his plans. Peter Parker was sent to investigate Kraft's adventures in cloning and ended up freeing Victoria and learning Kraft's true plans. Peter revealed the truth to the Monster, but Ivan overheard this and denied his claims. When the Monster continued to press him for answers, Ivan suddenly attacked him. The Monster, who wanted to believe Ivan was his friend, realized the truth and killed Ivan by snapping his neck with one hand, ending the hunchback's threat for good.
powers: Ivan appeared to possess and durability and the ability to recover from serious wounds easily. He also seems to have , as he was more than 100 years old and retained a body in its prime.
weaknesses: Ivan had very low intelligence.

ivan rasputin.name: Ivan (Rasputin)
ivan rasputin.origin: In the turbulent landscape of 1915 Czarist Russia, the enigmatic Grigory Rasputin's mystic presence captivated the attention of the formidable siblings, Ivan and Elena. Ivan, a figure rooted in the complexities of his homeland, found himself entangled in a web of mysticism and ambition alongside his sister, Elena, a Romani Mutant hailing from the distant lands of Siberia, possessing remarkable powers that intrigued both Rasputin and Mister Sinister. Rasputin, already celebrated for his extraordinary abilities, was drawn to the unique gifts displayed by the siblings. Simultaneously, Sinister perceived in Elena the potential to unlock the mysteries of mutant genetics. The initial encounter resulted in a clash, but it ultimately paved the way for a shared mission between Rasputin and Sinister—to forge a generation of superhumans by exploring the potential of breeding fully active mutants. Despite initial resistance from Rasputin, the collaboration unfolded with a controversial plan involving Rasputin's genetic material and clandestine unions. This plan took a significant turn when Rasputin, unexpectedly, seduced Ivan's sister Elena, leading to the birth of an illegitimate child, Grigory. Ivan, fueled by a deep-seated disgust over Rasputin's influence and the mistreatment of his sister, sought allies to eliminate the perceived threat. The Grand Duke Dmitri Pavlovich and Prince Felix Yusupov joined forces with Ivan in a covert plot to kill Rasputin. Miraculously revived from a near-death experience, Rasputin urgently sought Sinister's help. A mystic ritual unfolded, involving Rasputin's brides—mothers of his unborn children. Sacrificing his corporeal form, Rasputin split his consciousness among the unborn children, sealing his fate. In a twist of fate, Elena, seemingly fueled by fury, attacked Ivan with her powers, an act witnessed by Mister Sinister who believed it to be an act of fratricide. Decades later, the truth surfaced when Sinister visited Elena on her deathbed. She had let her brother live, dispelling the illusion of revenge that Sinister had believed to be the motive behind the apparent fratricidal act.

When Namor easily freed himself, he also made the American engineer, the true author of the tunnel project, escape, then knocked out Ivanoff and definitively sabotaged the work.

ivan kivelki.name: Ivan Kivelki
ivan kivelki.origin: thumb|left|150px Ivan Kivelki was a Mutant with the power of suggestion who worked for the Russian government. He was tricked into working at the disused clandestine biological warfare research station on Rebirth Island in order for the Russians to experiment on him. A Russian general exposed him to toxic gas designed to be a weapon used against Mutants. Instead, the compound absorbed into his skin and he survived, though disfigured, and began emitting the toxin from his body. Using his mutant ability he enslaved the remaining scientists and had them make a containment suit to contain the toxins being released from his body. Seeking to cure himself of the toxin, he sought out Beast after his work with the Legacy Virus. To capture him he somehow enslaved Darkstar and forced her to find the Beast and bring him there. Darkstar went to the X-Men who freed her from Black Death's control and brought them to the island. When the X-Men arrived Black Death revealed his history and explained he wanted Beast to develop a cure. Beast initially wanted helped from others like Reed Richards but Black Death refused and used his ability to enslave the rest of the X-Men and demanded if Beast didn't help or failed to help would use his powers to force the X-Men to kill each other one by one, and Black Death would then kill Beast. Beast agreed to help, though instead of making a cure he created a stun gun which the Beast used when the rest of the X-Men broke free. Darkstar then took Black Death into custody. ===M-DAY=== It is presumed he was depowered after the events of M-Day, however, his subsequent fate has not been recorded not confirmed.
powers: Power of Suggestion: Ivan was able to influence the actions of others with a low-level telepathic ability.

ivan petrovsky.name: Ivan Petrovsky
ivan petrovsky.origin: Despite he himself being a high ranking official in the communist government, Ivan Petrovsky's brother, Boris, was a secret supporter of democracy. After rumor of Boris' pro-democracy leanings were made aware to Ivan, he forced Boris to build a massive monument in honor of the government, in the hopes that it would divert attention from Boris' political views. After many months in seclusion, Boris radioed Ivan to inform him that the statue was complete. However, unbeknownst to Ivan, before he arrived to inspect the statue, it was possessed by an alien. When Ivan arrived to see the monument, he was terrified to find the statue walking around, causing massive destruction. Convinced it was a purposeful deceit by Boris, Ivan called in all types of military assistance to attack the statue, yet nothing proved powerful enough to stop the rampage. In a final attempt to subdue the statue, Ivan called in an air strike with a hydrogen bomb. Furious at Boris' perceived treason, Ivan left Boris bound to a chair in the strike zone. After Ivan departed, the alien inside the statue took pity on Boris, and destroyed the air strike team. When Ivan returned to find no damage to the statue, and Boris alive and well, Ivan demanded answers. Sensing the chance to champion democracy, Boris told Ivan that the statue was possessed by a higher power that was not pleased with the violent rule of the government, and that the statue would attack again if the government did not change its ways. While Ivan found the story fishy, the rest of the government felt they had no choice and loosened their grip on the country.

ivan pushkin.name: Ivan Pushkin
ivan pushkin.origin: Ivan Pushkin was the boss of the Solntsevskaya Bratva, and the head of the Molina, otherwise known as the Russian Mafia. He used to be an operative of SMERSH (Death to Spies), a ruthless Soviet counterintelligence agency. He had international goals, seeking to expand his operations into as many fields as possible. Upon the fall of the Soviet Union, he became a crimelord who established an expansive power base behind the Iron Curtain. He was a violent and sadistic man, who made the Kingpin look like a pussycat. Known as "Ivan the Terrible" he kept a dungeon with dead and dying victims, was brutally abusive to his mistresses who were kept submissive, and had no compunctions about personally killing a small child. He was expanding his operations outside of the former Eastern Bloc. The Solntsevskaya Bratva had established operations in North America and had members throughout Canada. Major Arthur Barrington posed a threat to his plans. While Barrington was being held by Department H, Pushkin sent out the brainwashed Maverick to assassinate him. However, he had a second target, Pierre Cloche, Department H's Director of Foreign Affairs, who had been interfering with his plans, as well. While Maverick took out the security forces (including Alphans Vindicator and Puck) Pushkin's operative Sickle attacked Cloche. However, Maverick overcame his brainwashing and, with the help of Vindicator, saved Cloche. However, Pushkin also sent his other operative Hammer who successfully killed Barrington. Pushkin later hired the Confessor to free Hammer and Sickle from the Ice Box. Afterwards he entered negotiations with A.I.M. which were a ruse, as he planned to steal their weaponry. He sent a force to A.I.M.'s hidden base, disguised as members of Hydra. They were partly successful, as they stole A.I.M. weaponry but Maverick and the Red Guardian prevented them from taking the biological warfare weapons.

ivan the sculptor.name: Ivan the Sculptor
ivan the sculptor.origin: The man known as Ivan the Sculptor was a starving artist. In 1941 he was commissioned by the city to make some sculptures, but they were ultimately rejected. In order to get revenge, Ivan hatched a complicated plot to get back at the men who rejected his work. He first gathered a group of loyal voodoo practitioners who worshipped a god called Os-Os-Me-Lim and convinced them that he had the magical power to make people ill and die by sculpting them. However, he simply had his loyal followers break into their homes and replace the light bulbs in their lamps with bulbs that emitted "Antinic Rays" which really caused the illnesses and death. Although Ivan was accused of the murders, no evidence could be found in court and he there was an acquittal of his crimes. By 1946, Ivan had taken up the lucrative business of threatening the lives of wealthy men, using these same methods to make them ill. For the most part they would pay his ransoms before the illnesses got terminal. When he targeted Mr. Drew, his daughter went to the police, attracting the attention of Captain America and Bucky in the process. They went to Ivan's studio to confront him with the situation, but he dismissed them. With no evidence to arrest Ivan, they were forced to leave. Ivan then sent some of his followers to check on Mr. Drew, leading to a clash with Captain America and Bucky. Cap, believing that the illnesses were psychological, decided to go back to Ivan's studio and he and Bucky were soon captured. Tied up, they watched in horror as Ivan was finishing a bust of Captain America which was making the hero sick. Bucky, breaking free, managed to free Cap and the duo easily beat Ivan and his men. With Ivan captured, he revealed the full scope of his scheme and was taken away. His subsequent fate is unknown.

ivana krakov.name: Ivana Krakov
ivana krakov.origin: Ivana and Valeri Krakov were among the first humans in space as cosmonauts of Vostok 7. However, they became lost in another dimension and their existence was censored, though they managed to send a signal back to Earth. thumb|left|Ivana dying in Dimitri's arms when she reenters spacetime As the dimension was outside reality, Ivana and Valeri did not age in the following decades, and their insignificance prevented them from being targeted by local lifeforms. Their son, Dimitri Krakov, vowed to find them, created a grid to locate the nexus of the signal, and opened a portal to rescue them. However, after rescuing Ivana, she quickly aged to death but she whispered to Dimitri that Valeri was still in the other dimension. Dimitri went back in to retrieve him but did not come back out.

ivory honeyshot.name: Ivory Honeyshot
ivory honeyshot.origin: ===Early Life=== Sir Ivory Honeyshot, was a Light Elf from the realm of Alfheim. He is Lord of Longrose Hall, Baron of the Order of the Petalblade and the First Cavalier in the Royal Dragoon of Queen Featherwine of the Fay. ===League of Realms=== Honeyshot was recruited to represent his people into the League of Realms, a team uniting warriors of the Nine Realms in order to hunt down Malekith the Accursed while he was slaughtering his people across the Nine Realms. That team was assembled as Thor desired to lead an army of Asgardians, but such action was considered an illegal incursion on the Realms. The team consisted of Screwbeard of Nidavellir, Ud the Troll, Lady Waziria of Svartalfheim, and Oggy of Jotunheim. The League was first sent in Nidavellir to protect the Dark Elves' Queen in exile, Alflyse, but their inability to work together properly led to their inability to defend her. The League clashed with Malekith's forces multiple times, eventually managing to save refugees in Alfheim, slaughtering Dark Elves refugees, but once again Malekith slipped away. In order to prevent his League from falling apart in front of him, Thor had the group headed to the nearest tavern, where Thor and Ogg engaged in a drinking contest, while the others wagered on the winner, narrowly drinking the giant under the table. The next day, the League headed to Jotunheim where Malekith was hunting down a group of Elves who hided among the Mountain Giants. Oggy was directly targeted by the Accursed, who leaped into his mouth and brutally slashed apart the Giant's brain with his blades, felling him. Having gone to the Frost Giants for help, Malekith was out of reach of the League of Realms. Enraged, the others had to hold Thor back to prevent an incursion inside the Frost Giants territory and a larger conflict. After burying Oggy, the League went to Vanaheim and found more Elves dead, slain fighting amongst themselves. Thor realized that there was to be a traitor in their midst. Thor cast a spell and, accusing Ud of being the traitor, seemingly executed him against Honeyshot and the League's advices. Ud was transported elsewhere in Vanaheim with a note addressed to the League pinned to his backside and leading them to the Midgard location of the Dark Elves refugees. That rash action caused the league to split, with only Lady Waziria as companion to Thor. While the two of them headed to Midgard to find the Council of the Unhallowed, the Dark Elf ruling council in hiding, and urged them to unite against Malekith, the rest of the League found Ud, as confused as them. Back in Midgard, Thor accused Waziria of being a traitor as Malekith had followed them to the butcher shop. Enraged, she blasted Thor with a mystical bolt, resulting in a strange creature wrenching itself from inside of Thor, revealing that Malekith had been ahead of the League all along by bugging Thor. The League then showed up with Ud. As Screwbeard was about to killed by his own dynamite stabbed into his hand, Ud saved him by cutting his hand off. Alongside with Thor and the Dark Elves, they took down Malekith, but the fight was stopped by the Council decision to have him their king. During the meeting on Asgardia, Honeyshot pressed the issue of Malekith's prison sentence, and later came to comfort the disgusted Thor, recalling him the fact that they had together built the first step of brotherhood and peace between the Realms.
abilities: Honeyshot is a marksman.
weapons: Two pistols with iron bullets.

ivory wench.name: Ivory Wench
ivory wench.origin: The Ivory Wench was accused of being a witch during the Salem witch trials of 1692. As she was about to be burned Forbush Man arrived from the modern age. He attempted to assist with the burning but revealed that no one was burned at Salem, so the townspeople decided to hang both the Ivory Wench and the Forbush Man. Just before they were hung Forbush Man suggested that the Ivory Wench might have the same abilities as her descendant, the Scarlet Wench. The Ivory Wench was able to summon an image of the white-costumed Vision, which caused all the townspeople to flee. The two got out of rope and began to fall in love, but the Forbush Man was returned to the modern day.

izanami randall.name: Izanami Randall
izanami randall.origin: Izanami Randall was a Japanese American woman living in San Francisco. She worked as a manhua store cashier. thumb|left|Becoming Nightmask On March 2nd, 2006, a White Event occurred. Izanami Randall became Nightmask and woke up in the Superflow. Having attended a party the day before, she initially thought she was drugged. She met a Communications Station who explained to her the Superflow and the White Event. She learned that the White Event also manifested a Starbrand (Ken Connell), a Justice (John Tensen), and a Cipher (Jenny Swann). After downloading information about them, she became worried about the Starbrand, fearing that he might kill everyone. She figured out that the Superflow could be used to traverse distances in the real world and transported herself from San Francisco to Optima Down, Oklahoma. While in the Superflow, the US military launched an attack on Ken Connell and Izanami saw it in the Superflow. She transported to his location before using the Superflow to transport them both back to her home in San Francisco. She and Ken laid low for a while before discovering that there were other superhumans emerging after her manhua store got bombed by one.
abilities: Izanami can "download" information regarding her "missions". It can be assumed, although she calls herself Japanese-American, Izanami can speak Japanese.
weaknesses: She is very inexperienced in matters involving the Superflow.

izo.name: Izo
izo.origin: Several hundred years ago in Japan, Izo was one of the founding members of the Hand and was a close follower of the leader, Kagenobu Yoshioka. Yoshioka was a blind martial artist, who used a radar sense to fight and "see" the world, and Izo blinded himself in order to see the world in the same way Yoshioka did and develop his radar sense. However, when Yoshioka died, Izo left the Hand because it was growing darker and more dangerous, becoming the Hand that is known today. In order to counter the evils of Hand, he founded a rival martial arts group, known as the Chaste to combat his former group. However, fifty-five years prior to the present, Izo was soon thrown out by his students for his excessive drinking and gambling, which they found disgusting and disgraceful. Leadership of the Chaste was then given to Stick, much to Izo's disgust as he felt the strict and prudish rules of the current Chaste would eventually make them no different from the Hand. ===Modern Times=== In the modern era, Izo was present when Matthew Murdock was struck by a chemical container, and reported the incident to Stick anonymously. He placed moles in the Hand organization such as Black Tarantula who could overcome the Hand's dark influence and feed him information. He also trained the ninja Lady Bullseye, promising to make her leader of the Hand, but betrayed her and instead chose to support Daredevil in that endeavor, hoping that he might turn the Hand back towards the light or destroy it for good. However, Izo was later captured and apparently killed by the Hand under Daredevil as part of his final initiation test to become their new leader. However, the death was a ruse as Izo managed to slow his heartbeat to place himself in a coma and simulate death, before being awakened to plot on the Hand's destruction. However, Matt started growing more corrupt in his desire to use the Hand to stop crime in Hell's Kitchen, having corrupt cops murdered and later forcing Izo to leave town or suffer more attacks from the Hand. Izo was later approached by Elektra when she became worried over Matt's increasing extremism in controlling Hell's Kitchen as his new Shadowland and held off a swarm of Hand ninjas when they came to attack the two while on an escape route. Izo later appeared in New York to lead a team to stop Matt as he had become possessed by an evil force leading the Hand known as the Beast which Izo reluctantly admitted responsibility for.
weapons: Izo often carries a wooden staff that hides a sword.

izumi ishihara.name: Izumi Ishihara
izumi ishihara.origin: The Hachiman was called in by the Daichi Doku to help them take over San Genaro, territory in New York City under the protection of the Geraci Family. After a short fight between Geraci and Daichi Doku soldiers, The Punisher bested and spared the Hachiman, sending him back to his employers to set up peace talks. Castle's sparing of his life left him with a debt of giri ninjo to Castle, which he vowed to repay and then kill Castle. He joins an alliance to destroy the Geraci family, and kills top lieutenant Kim Sung Young. Jigsaw had captured the last surviving Geraci lieutenant, Leslie (along with her siblings), and intended to kill her, but Hachiman convinced him it would be dishonorable. During the final confrontation with Castle, Hachiman attacked and disarms Firefox, damaging his cybernetics. He considered his debt to Castle paid, and left, stating he will kill Castle when they next meet.
powers: Through unknown means, Hachiman harnesses his Chi to create a force field that repels high velocity projectiles. Slower projectiles, such as arrows, can penetrate the force field.

j 97.name: J-97
j 97.origin: Agent J-97 was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. By the fall of 1942 he was located in New York City and had amassed a massive spy network. Using a transmitter to turn on the air raid sirens in the city, making an unscheduled black out, Agent J-97 would send his minions out to cause accidents and attempt to destroy New York's infrastructure and military defenses. All of his agents were equipped with radio transmitters to receive their orders and they would obey every command, especially the strict orders to commit suicide when captured to avoid revealing plans. From the moment the fake air raid began, the Human Torch and Toro began searching for it's caused and stumbled upon J-97's agents. The two heroes would prevent the destruction of the New York City water supply, a power plant and the 18th Regiment Armory. It would not be until their last stop that they were able to keep one of J-97's men alive long enough to learn of J-97's location and his plot. Getting the city to turn the electricity back on, the Torch and Toro raced to J-97's hideout in an abandoned train yard and quickly subdued him and the other spies in the location. Once the hideout was secured, the Torch then imitated J-97's voice and called all the other spies back to base. When they returned, they found an army of FBI agents waiting for them and were all taken into custody. J-97's subsequent fate during the war is unknown.
weapons: J-97 was armed with a pistol.

j arthur crank.origin: J. Arthur Crank was first seen when he attempted to become his own super-hero. First he made a costume to disguise himself but was immediately recognized he then tried to develop a superpower but realized he already had one and so he became the crank-caller superhero. Crank was later hired by Rita the Director to play the role of the Rhino in her film. This infuriated the real Rhino who knocked Crank out and took his place. When he went for a walk of April 1st, J. Arthur Crank was targeted by the evil prankster April Fool who made a series of jokes against him and even after Spider-Man arrived April Fool continued to make jokes until he was tricked by a joke made by Valerie the Librarian, this made Crank happy. Crank warned Spider-Man that there was a vampire in an old house and then accompanied him into the house. The two realizes that the Vampire was a good person and the culprit of the ghostly sounds that were causing a disturbance that came from the house were caused by the Mad Thinker and his robot. When Arthur was taking his weekly bath, the Uninvited sneaked into Crank's home and robbed him of his rubber duck that he was playing with. Crank was present at the surprise party for Fargo North's birthday.

j arthur grover.name: J. Arthur Grover
j arthur grover.origin: J. Arthur Grover was the Director of F.B.I., as well as the head behind Operation Rebirth. While U.S. Army General Phillips and the disguised Nazi spy Heinz Kruger were talking to President Roosevelt at the White House, Grover was called inside the meeting room by the President himself, who ordered him to bring the two officers to Operation Rebirth's facility. Grover then identified himself to F.B.I. Agent X-13, who let the three men enter inside the secret laboratory under the Curios Shop facade; however, after Operation Rebirth's Professor Reinstein had subjected Steve Rogers to his Super-Soldier Serum, Heinz Kruger revealed himself to be a Nazi spy killing both Reinstein and Grover. Rogers then proceeded to beat Kruger, accidentally killing him.

A possible in-universe explanation to this retcon comes from : several Golden Age Timely Comics stories also were comic books on Earth-616, functioning as fictionalized adaptations of real happened events. j elliot osbourne.name: J. Elliot Osbourne
j elliot osbourne.origin: J. Elliot "Jacko" Osbourne was the wealthy and arrogant leader of an exclusive fraternity from Georgia College whose members treated vandalism, intimidation, and reckless acts as part of their initiation rituals. Seeking a greater thrill, Osbourne became obsessed with hunting and destroying Man-Thing. Under his leadership, the fraternity vandalized the Cypress County Sheriff's Office, humiliating John Daltry and defacing treasured personal belongings, including a photograph of Daltry's late wife. Not content with this, Osbourne and his followers ambushed the sheriff, handcuffed him, and forced him to accompany them into the Everglades while they hunted Man-Thing using highly volatile chemical compounds capable of devastating the entire swamp ecosystem. When the creature finally appeared, Osbourne's plans quickly unraveled. His attempt to run Man-Thing down resulted in a crash that left fraternity member Allen Walsh trapped beneath a burning vehicle. Ignoring Allen's plight, Osbourne ordered the others to continue the hunt. As the confrontation escalated, Man-Thing seized Osbourne. Overcome with fear, the young man dropped the container of chemicals he was carrying. The substance ignited instantly, triggering a massive explosion that killed Osbourne. His death brought an end to the fraternity's reckless crusade against the swamp creature.

j norton.name: J. Norton

When Maijus discovered that he could kill anybody he pleased by tearing up a photograph of that person, he went on a power trip, and began killing and stealing at whim. When Norton called Maijus into his office to discuss missing funds, Maijus confessed outright, and after Norton threatened to call the police, Maijus tore up his portrait. Norton then fired Maijus. While his fate is unrevealed, it is more than likely that he died the next day due to Maijus' powers.

j d mccready.name: J.D. McCready
j d mccready.origin: J.D. McCready was a member of the Hell Riders, a biker gang, who met Bullseye during a night where he stopped at their dive bar to have a game of pool. A rival gang wanted to start a turf war, and Bullseye sided with the Hell Riders, killing the members of the rival gang. Believing that it was because Bullseye liked their style, McCready began to consider Bullseye an honorary member of their gang, though Bullseye flipped a coin to know which side join, just to kill them quickly and resume his game. McCready eventually watched on television the news of Bullseye's death, and proposed to organize a proper burial for him. McCready and the rest of the Hell Riders kidnapped a young man named Denny Deaver, journalist Ben Urich, a priest, and a group of tourist to act as mourners during the funeral. McCready threatened Urich to cover the story, until he noticed that Urich's notepad was empty. Actually, Urich had left his notepad behind to tip Daredevil, who attacked the funeral with the Hand, and took McCready to the dungeons in the Shadowland Fortress.

j j jones.name: J.J. Jones
j j jones.origin: J.J. Jones was a successful businessman and chief rival of industrialist Silas Haggle. After securing a major contract that Haggle had hoped to obtain, Jones unknowingly became the target of Haggle’s anger. While reading news of Jones’ success, Haggle used an enchanted mirror to wish that Jones would disappear permanently. The wish caused Jones to become mystically imprisoned inside the mirror, his image appearing trapped within its surface. Jones remained confined alongside other victims of Haggle’s wishes until Haggle later made a final wish that resulted in all prisoners being released. Jones was freed when the mirror reversed its effects, imprisoning Haggle instead.

j p finance.name: J.P. Finance
j p finance.origin: J.P. Finance was an associate of banker John Wolfe. On the day that Wolfe was expecting a visit from Finance, he asked his daughter Hedy to fill in for his sick secretary. When a robber approached Wolfe's office, Hedy let him in, mistakenly assuming that he was J.P. Finance. The real Finance arrived shortly after, and Hedy almost drove him out until she realized she had made a mistake. She rushed to her father's office to find him bound and gagged, and the robber gone.

j r van de kalb.name: J.R. Van De Kalb
j r van de kalb.origin: J.R. Van De Kalb was a multimillionaire insurance tycoon who owned a collection of rare American postage stamps. He went to Christie's Auction House in Los Angeles to sell it but the supervillain Enforcer and his gang were planning to rob him at that moment. The Enforcer was unaware that media mogul Rupert Dockery was spying on him and knew where the Enforcer was going to strike, which Dockery took advantage of to get the exclusive on these hits. In that case, LAPD Captain Alexander Walsh had pressured Dockery to collaborate with him, and Dockery agreed to tell Walsh where the Enforcer was going to strike in exchange for the police not sharing that information with Dockery's competitors, and not demanding the source. When the Enforcer attacked Van De Kalb at Christie's Auction House, the police were waiting for him and set a trap for him, but one of the Enforcer's accomplices, the coerced superheroine Spider-Woman, helped the Enforcer escape, apparently without the loot. Dockery covered the story, expanding the popularity of his paper.

jaagur.name: Jaagur
jaagur.origin: Jaagur was the commander of a vast army in a distant galaxy. He had a brother Umbra, with whom he was at war with for control of their galaxy. In response to acquiring a powerful device that could siphon energy from a distant star into his body armor, Umbra instigated a war with Jaagur by sending an unencrypted signal that revealed the location of his forces to lure Jaagur to Warworld. Jaagur followed the signal to Warworld, arriving in full battle armor that allowed him to easily destroy the fortifications of Warworld. The armor however was not strong enough to withstand Umbra's attack when they met, and Umbra easily beat Jaagur. thumb|left|Merged form Jaagur merged with Umbra when Mister Fantastic shorted out Umbra's Star-Tap siphon, which transported them to just outside Earth's solar system. The dominant personality was Umbra, and Jaagur seemed to have little to no control in the merged form. They traveled to Earth where they clashed with the Fantastic Four. After Reed successfully splits Jaagur and Umbra, Umbra attacked Jaagur and slammed a power coupling into Jaagur's armor, creating an explosion. After the explosion, neither Jaagur nor Umbra are found. Reed hypothesizes that they were destroyed.

jaard.origin: Jaard was a member of an Elder Race, an ancient advanced civilization who lived secluded from the world on an unnamed mountain. Their home was attacked and taken away by an unknown alien race. They managed to overcome the aliens and return the mountain to Earth, but only Jaard survived, having been changed into the creature called Starseed. He landed the mountain in Los Angeles, causing a series of earthquakes and attracting the Legion of Monsters who attacked him. He briefly returned them to their human states, but died from the injuries sustained during the battle, returning them to their beast/monster states.

jaboa murphy.name: Jaboa Murphy
jaboa murphy.origin: Jaboa Murphy is an Australian resident who is believed to be an ancestor of Michael Korvac, a ruthless computerized villain from the 31st Century of Earth-691. Years ago, Korvac traveled to the modern age of Earth-616 where he stole information from the Worldship of Galactus, endowing him with godlike powers. Korvac then attempted to take over the universe, but he was opposed by the Guardians of the Galaxy and the Avengers. During the final battle, Galactus became aware that Korvac tampered with his computers and sought to destroy him. He then fired a blast from the Ultimate Nullifier toward Earth to destroy Korvac. Detecting this, Korvac then vacated his body sending out a genetic packet to his closest living ancestor, leaving the Avengers and the Guardians to think that Korvac was dead. In reality, the genetic packet containing Korvac's mind and power was transferred to Jaboa where they remained dormant for years. Eventually, the Guardians of the Galaxy became aware of this deception and returned to the modern era of Earth-616. This time, they enlisted the aid of the Fantastic Four to help them stop Korvac. With the inventions of the Fantastic Four's Mister Fantastic, they tracked Jaboa as she was wandering in a daze across the Australian outback. When they attacked, Korvac's personality and powers took control of Jaboa's body, and he incapacitated everyone except Reed Richards. Reed used his Time Platform to travel back in time to the first Korvac battle and redirect the beams of the Ultimate Nullifier into the present. When faced with imminent destruction once again, Korvac fled Jaboa's body and disappeared into the future to try his plan again. Jaboa's subsequent fate following the departure of Korvac from her body is unrevealed at this time.
powers: Jaboa briefly wielded those of the Korvac of Earth-691.

family: Michael Korvac (alternate reality descendant in the 31st Century)
